about: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoder): search places by free text or structured address, reverse-geocode coordinates, fetch full place details by OSM id, and check server/data status.

commands.summary: Free-text geocoding search for places, addresses or POIs by name. Returns matching OSM objects with coordinates.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query, e.g. a place name, address or landmark

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of results (1-40, server default 10) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: countrycodes
params.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to restrict results to, e.g. us or de,at

params.name: accept_language
params.description: Preferred language(s) for result names, e.g. en or de,en

params.name: layer
params.description: Restrict results to a thematic layer (comma-separated allowed)

params.name: exclude_place_ids
params.description: Comma-separated places already shown, to get the next page of results. Format: OSM type letter plus OSM id (N/W/R + osm_id), e.g. W518071791,R126326

params.name: addressdetails
params.description: Include a broken-down address object (house_number, road, city, postcode, country...) per result

params.name: polygon_geojson
params.description: Include the full GeoJSON outline of each result. This can be very large.

commands.summary: Structured address/POI search using separate fields (amenity, street, city, county, state, country, postalcode). Can be restricted to a bounding box.

params.name: amenity
params.description: Name or type of POI, e.g. cafe

params.name: street
params.description: House number and street name, e.g. 10 Downing Street

params.name: city
params.description: City / town name

params.name: county
params.description: County name

params.name: state
params.description: State / province name

params.name: country
params.description: Country name or code

params.name: postalcode
params.description: Postal code

params.name: viewbox
params.description: Preferred search area as lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2 (two corners), e.g. 2.33,48.86,2.37,48.84

params.name: bounded
params.description: With viewbox: only return results inside the box

params.name: dedupe
params.description: Merge duplicate results such as multiple segments of the same street. Server default is true. Set to false to keep all.

params.name: polygon_threshold
params.description: Simplification tolerance in degrees for returned polygons, e.g. 0.01

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of results (1-40) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: countrycodes
params.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes to restrict results

params.name: accept_language
params.description: Preferred language(s) for names, e.g. en

params.name: exclude_place_ids
params.description: Comma-separated places already shown (N/W/R + osm_id), for the next page

params.name: addressdetails
params.description: Include a broken-down address object per result

params.name: polygon_geojson
params.description: Include GeoJSON outlines (can be large)

commands.summary: Get full details of an OSM place by type and id: names, extratags (wikidata, population, website), address hierarchy, linked places, centroid. Optionally includes child places or search keywords.

params.name: osmtype
params.description: OSM object type: N=node, W=way, R=relation

params.name: osmid
params.description: OSM object id (osm_id from search results)

params.name: class
params.description: OSM class/category to pick when an object has several (category from search results), e.g. boundary

params.name: hierarchy
params.description: Include child places that have this place as parent

params.name: keywords
params.description: Include the name and address search keywords indexed for this place

params.name: polygon_geojson
params.description: Include the full geometry as GeoJSON (can be large)

commands.summary: Reverse geocode a latitude/longitude to the nearest OSM object and its address, at a chosen detail level (zoom).

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees

params.name: zoom
params.description: Address detail level 0-18: 3=country, 5=state, 8=county, 10=city, 12=town/borough, 14=suburb, 16=major street, 17=street, 18=building

params.name: layer
params.description: Restrict to a thematic layer

params.name: accept_language
params.description: Preferred language(s) for names, e.g. en

params.name: polygon_geojson
params.description: Include the GeoJSON outline of the result (can be large)

commands.summary: Check Nominatim server status, software/database version and when the OSM data was last updated.
